title: Painter and Spectral Muse
description: A man in a paint-splattered white shirt stands in a dimly lit studio, reaching toward a large canvas with both hands covered in dripping yellow-green paint. The canvas displays a surreal, glowing figure with multiple distorted screaming faces emerging from swirling yellow, green and purple vortexes against a dark background.
prompt: A male artist in a dimly lit studio stands before a massive easel, his white shirt and hands covered in dripping fluorescent yellow-green paint as he reaches toward the canvas. The large painting depicts a terrifying spectral figure with multiple screaming ghostly faces swirling out of a chaotic vortex of luminous yellow, lime green and deep purple paint strokes, dark atmospheric studio with warm window light in the background.
